abstract: Complete hydatidiform (also referred to as hydatiform) mole with coexisting live fetus is an exceedingly rare event. The fetus usually has a normal karyotype, and approximately 25-40% chance of survival, if pregnancy is allowed to continue until reasonable fetal lung maturity is achieved. However, risk of maternal complications including preeclampsia and subsequent trophoblastic disease are significant. We report a case of a 19-year-old primigravida, at 25 weeks gestation with a complete hydatidiform mole and a coexisting live fetus. She developed severe preeclampsia with uncontrolled hypertension, and pregnancy was terminated by caesarean section, after a short course of dexamethasone to accelerate fetal lung maturity. A morphologically normal live female fetus and placenta were delivered without complications, along with a separate mass of complete mole. The postpartum course was complicated by uterine choriocarcinoma with metastases to lung and left kidney, which responded to chemotherapy. Our case is a rare example of a twin gestation composed of a complete hydatidiform mole with a coexisting live fetus, and illustrates the associated spectrum of maternal complications that mandate close pre- and post-natal surveillance.
abstract_ja: 完全胞状奇胎と生存胎児が併存する状況は極めてまれである。胎児は通常正常核型を有し、十分な胎児肺成熟が得られるまで妊娠を継続した場合、生存率は約25〜40%と報告されている。しかし、子癇前症を含む母体合併症およびその後の栄養膜疾患のリスクは著しい。19歳初産婦、妊娠25週で完全胞状奇胎と生存胎児の併存例を報告する。重症子癇前症と制御不能の高血圧を呈したため、胎児肺成熟促進のためのデキサメタゾン短期投与後、帝王切開で妊娠を終結した。形態学的に正常な生存女児と胎盤、および別個の完全胞状奇胎の塊が無合併症で娩出された。産後経過は、肺および左腎への転移を伴う子宮絨毛癌により複雑化し、化学療法に反応した。本症例は、完全胞状奇胎と生存胎児からなる双胎妊娠のまれな例であり、出生前後の密接な監視の必要性を示すものである。
